accounts.deleteUsed_other: This account and its {{count}} transactions will be permanently deleted.
accounts.deleteTransfers_one: 1 of them is a transfer with another account, so that account's balance will change too. Archive instead to keep everything as it is.
accounts.deleteTransfers_other: {{count}} of them are transfers with other accounts, so those balances will change too. Archive instead to keep everything as it is.

accounts.currencyChangeMessage_other: {{count}} transactions on this account are in {{list}}. They keep that currency, so their money will show as a separate {{list}} line on the account.
accounts.missingRates: Not counted: {{list}}. Set exchange rates in Settings.
accounts.defaultForHint: New income or expenses start on this account. You can still pick another one each time.
accounts.includeInTotalHint: Adds this account's balance to the total at the top.
accounts.showInExpensesHint: Counts this account's expenses and income in Categories, Transactions and Overview, and gives it a tile in Categories. Money sent to a savings tile counts as spending, minus what comes back. For a debt only money you lend counts, minus what's paid back; borrowing and paying back a loan don't, as what you buy with the money already counts. Moving money between everyday accounts doesn't count.

groupHint.savings: Money set aside. Listed separately and left out of totals unless you switch it on below or pick it in the accounts filter.
groupHint.debt: A person or loan you lend to or borrow from.

debts.empty: No debts yet. Add a debt account for each person or loan you want to keep track of.
debts.hint: To lend money, make a transfer from your account to the debt. When you get paid back, transfer from the debt to your account. Borrowing works the other way round.

instalments.title: Pay in instalments
instalments.monthsRange: A whole number of months, from {{min}} to {{max}}.
instalments.interestHint: If your bank adds interest, enter the total you'll pay as the amount.
instalments.autoPayHint: Adds each month's payment to the card on its due date, from this account.
instalments.includes: Includes {{amount}} in instalments still to come
instalments.payOffAndFee: Pay off and add a fee
instalments.payOffConfirm: Move the {{amount}} still to come onto your next statement? Your bank may charge a fee for settling early.
instalments.deleteConfirm_one: Delete the {{count}} instalment of this plan? Use this for a plan entered by mistake; a cancelled purchase is a refund.
instalments.deleteConfirm_other: Delete all {{count}} instalments of this plan? Use this for a plan entered by mistake; a cancelled purchase is a refund.

cards.daysHint: Days of the month. In a shorter month the last day is used.
cards.dueAfterRange: A whole number of days, from 1 to {{max}}.
cards.dueAfterTooMany: That sounds like the total from the day you buy. Payment is usually due 21–30 days after the statement; for 55 days in total, enter about 25.
cards.minHint: Optional: the minimum your bank asks for, as a share of the statement with a lowest amount.
cards.cashFeeHint: Optional: what your bank charges for taking cash out on this card. It's on the bank's fee list.
cards.minimumPaid: Minimum paid · pay the rest by {{date}} to avoid interest.
cards.clear: Nothing to pay from this statement
cards.upcomingNote: The next statement includes anything still unpaid. Later ones show only charges dated in their cycle, such as instalments, as if each statement before is paid in full.
cards.interestFreeNote: Only while each statement is paid in full by its due date.
cards.cashInterestNote: Interest is charged from the day you withdraw. Paying it off early costs less.
cards.hint: Pay your card with a transfer from your bank account. It isn't counted as spending, because your purchases already were.

finances.hint: Assets are all positive balances, debts all negative ones, across every account. Your default income and expense accounts count as one balance: what's left after spending.

profile.name: Your name
profile.backupHint: Saves all your data to a file you can restore on any device.

dbError.title: Budgy couldn't open your data
dbError.message: Nothing was changed. This can happen when the phone is low on storage or the browser blocks storage (for example in private browsing). Close Budgy completely and open it again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Budgy
welcome.body: Track your money simply. Pick your language to begin.

log.title: Log spending in two taps
log.body: Tap a category, type the amount. Your budgets fill as you spend.

money.title: All your money, one place
money.body: Accounts, credit cards, debts and several currencies together.

insight.title: See where it goes
insight.body: Transactions by day, the trend, and your budgets.

private.title: Yours, on your phone
private.body: No ads, and it works offline. Sign in to sync and back up.
private.bodyPro: No ads, and it works offline. Budgy Pro adds bank texts and sync across your phones.

currency.title: Which currency do you use?
currency.body: Your accounts, totals and reports will use it. You can change it later in Settings.

bubble.title: Tap to log spending
bubble.body: Tap a category, type the amount, and it is saved. Hold one to see its transactions.

center.title: Expenses or income
center.body: Tap the middle to switch between spending and income.

period.title: Pick a period
period.body: Tap to choose a period. Swipe the page to move between periods.

balance.title: Your balance
balance.body: Tap to choose which accounts count toward it.

edit.title: Edit your categories
edit.body: Add or edit categories. In edit mode, drag to reorder them.

menu.title: Your menu
menu.body: Profile, Settings, Data and more live here.

tabs.title: Accounts, Debts, Finances
tabs.body: Swipe to move between the three tabs.

add.title: Add an account
add.body: Create a new account in any currency.

row.title: Open an account
row.body: Tap to edit it. A credit card's arrow opens its statement.

add.title: Add a transaction
add.body: Tap here to log a new one.

row.title: Select several
row.body: Long-press to select more. Delete, filter, or change their date, account or category.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find transactions by note, category or amount.

tiles.title: Your totals
tiles.body: Income, spending and what is left this period.

trend.title: The trend
trend.body: See how your spending moves over time.

budgets.title: Your budgets
budgets.body: Watch each budget fill as you spend.

fromto.title: From and to
fromto.body: Where the money comes from and where it goes.

keypad.title: Type the amount
keypad.body: You can type sums too, like 120+35.

date.title: Pick the date
date.body: Tap to log it on another day.

note.title: Add a note
note.body: Optional, but it makes searching easier.

currency.title: Main currency
currency.body: Totals use it. Other currencies get their own rates here.

tours.title: Tours and tips
tours.body: Replay the welcome and the page tips any time.

scan.title: Scan bank texts
scan.body: Find spending in your bank messages.

card.title: Handle texts in bulk
card.body: Long-press to select several. File them in one category, combine them, or take money off a purchase.

controls.currencyFailed: Couldn't set the currency. Try again.

settings.title: Tours and tips
settings.replayToast: Tips will show again as you visit each page.

reminder.never: Your data is only on this phone. Back it up so you don't lose it.
reminder.stale: Your last backup is more than a month old.

cloud.hint: Sign-in and sync are part of Budgy Pro. They keep a copy of your data in your account, so you can get it back if you change phones or reinstall Budgy. Without an account, everything stays on this device.

sms.proBanner: Bank texts are part of Budgy Pro. Your texts are kept here until you renew.
sms.permissionDenied: Budgy can't read texts. To allow it, open Android Settings → Apps → Budgy → Permissions → SMS.
sms.disclosureBody: Budgy reads texts on this phone only, and only from the senders you list. While a text waits for your review, its message is kept on this phone, and it is deleted once you confirm or dismiss it. Budgy keeps the amount, date, merchant and last digits. When you are signed in, the last card digits and merchant names Budgy learns are saved to your account, so your other phones can use them.
